TakeDamageSfx.rationale: Presentation only (SHARED-FINDINGS section 4): no mechanical reader.

AfterAddedToRoom.rationale: The sim has no add-to-room phase - creature creation *is* construction - so AfterAddedToRoom's effect is applied from __init__ (chomper.py:36-38). SHARED-FINDINGS section 2's shared verdict, copied: the game runs these from MonsterModel.AfterAddedToRoom via CombatManager.AfterCreatureAdded (CombatManager.cs:860-867) inside StartCombatInternal (CombatManager.cs:394-398), i.e. after every creature is on the board and before Hook.BeforeCombatStart (CombatManager.cs:403); the sim runs them at create_monsters (combat.py:134), before relics attach (combat.py:157-159), before belt potions register (combat.py:164-166), before the parity Niche HP roll (combat.py:152-153) and before hooks.on_combat_start (combat.py:208). Same observable today on all three of section 2's clauses (listener set / HP-roll inversion / roll ordering); executed for this unit by `py audit/tools/monster_probes_b05.py rocket-ctor`, which prints the listener set at monster-construction time for a two-monster hive encounter: ['CombatHistory','StrikeCard','DefendCard', the previously-created monster's own powers] - no relic, no potion. Rule 7: the rationale leans on sts2_rl/combat.py, sts2_rl/relics/ruined_helmet.py, sts2_rl/relics/unsettling_lamp.py and src/Core/Combat/CombatManager.cs, which this record does NOT hash. Amount matches: Chomper.cs:52 applies ArtifactPower 2m to itself.

GenerateMoveStateMachine.rationale: Two-node cycle, no branch state. C# (Chomper.cs:55-65): CLAMP_MOVE (MultiAttackIntent(ClampDamage=8, 2)) .FollowUpState = SCREECH_MOVE (StatusIntent(3)) .FollowUpState = CLAMP_MOVE; states registered [CLAMP, SCREECH]; initialState = _screamFirst ? SCREECH : CLAMP. The sim is a line-for-line transliteration with the same two states, the same follow-ups, the same registration order and the same initial-state ternary. Ids are identical (SHARED-FINDINGS section 3 does not even apply).

guards.rationale: ChompersNormal.cs:17-27 GenerateMonsters builds two Chompers and sets ScreamFirst = true on the second; ChompersEncounter.create_monsters (chomper.py:69-70) returns [Chomper(...), Chomper(..., scream_first=True)] in the same order.
Chomper.cs:24 declares _clampRepeat but no member reads it (the hit count at :69 is the literal 2). Nothing to port.
